products.title: PAYNTR Golf X Jones Sports Co. Dual Shoe Bag
products.body_html:
Elevate your travel gear with the JONES SPORTS CO. x PAYNTR Golf Shoe Bag, a collaboration that merges rugged durability with sophisticated design. Modeled after the bottom compartment of the acclaimed Scout Weekender Duffle, this shoe bag offers premium protection for your footwear in a sleek, standalone package AND holds two pairs of shoes. 

Built to withstand the rigors of travel and the golf course, the exterior is crafted from 900d Ripstop in a deep, classic Black. This high-denier fabric ensures superior resistance against tears and abrasions. The bag features sturdy **PP Twill Webbing** handles for easy carrying, finished with a stealthy Black EPD coating on the hardware.

  • Main Material: 900d Ripstop (Black)
  • Hardware: #8 Standard Coil Zippers with Zoom Short Pulls
  • Accents: Distinctive white zipper pull strings (2.75" looped length) for easy grip and visual contrast.

Unzip the top lid—constructed in the same reliable style as the Jones Scout Duffle—to reveal a thoughtfully designed interior. The lining features a contrasting field khaki liner, making it easy to see your contents.

  • An internal foldable divider allows you to separate shoes or organize accessories, lined in a vibrant "Iceland Poppy" for a pop of color.
